description: A link that opens the Vargov®Design 3D configurator with the zone dimensions already filled in: length, width and, optionally, the height of the composition, in millimetres. With an LC code the configurator opens with that composition; compositions it does not build to room dimensions open without them (calculation: individual or not_by_room_size).

lang.description: Language of the result: ru, en, de, it, fr, es, vi or ar. Default en.

name: configurator_link
title: Configurator link with dimensions
